name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px inner #ffffff offset to all interactive elements. This ensures keyboard users see clear focus states at standard touch target sizes, improving navigation for everyone. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring that may feel bolder in high-contrast modes, but the color contrast (4.5:1 on light backgrounds) keeps it usable.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring risks colliding with adjacent elements in dense UIs, making it hard to distinguish focus. A 2px ring risks disappearing entirely on high-DPI screens where pixels blur. Settle it with a 3px ring at 80% opacity—clear enough to see, small enough to avoid collision. Test on actual devices with keyboard nav.
